title: MiniURL
description: OAuth 2.1 short-link tools for AI agents with scoped tokens, approvals, audit logs, and revocation.
summary: OAuth 2.1 short-link tools for AI agents with scoped tokens, approvals, audit logs, and revocation.
offersHint: OAuth 2.1 short-link tools for AI agents with scoped tokens, approvals, audit logs, and revocation. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://workers.miniurl.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: create_guest_token
toolsPreview.description: Create a short-lived MiniURL guest bearer token. Legacy MCP sessions retain it; stateless clients must pass the returned gt_ token explicitly on later requests. shorten_url can provision one automatically.

toolsPreview.name: clear_authentication
toolsPreview.description: Clear authentication retained by a legacy MCP session. Stateless clients clear authentication by omitting the Authorization header on later requests.

toolsPreview.name: shorten_url
toolsPreview.description: Create a MiniURL short link for a supplied HTTP or HTTPS destination. Use when the user asks to shorten a URL or generate a MiniURL link. This is an additive external write; do not fetch or open the destination. If no authentication is supplied, MiniURL automatically starts a guest flow. Reuse idempotency_key when retrying the same logical request.

toolsPreview.name: send_registration_code
toolsPreview.description: Send a 6-digit registration code to the user email, using the current guest session.

toolsPreview.name: verify_registration_code
toolsPreview.description: Verify the emailed code, create the account, claim guest links, and continue with OAuth 2.1 + PKCE. Long-lived API keys are never returned over MCP.

toolsPreview.name: get_account_status
toolsPreview.description: Inspect the current guest/free/pro account status, remaining quota, and feature availability.

toolsPreview.name: start_pro_upgrade
toolsPreview.description: Create a shortened checkout link for upgrading the current registered account to Pro.

toolsPreview.name: list_domains
toolsPreview.description: List domains available to the current registered account, including miniurl.com and active custom domains.

toolsPreview.name: add_domain
toolsPreview.description: Request a custom domain to be connected to MiniURL. Agent domain changes require human approval by default.

toolsPreview.name: delete_domain
toolsPreview.description: Delete a custom domain and its linked URLs after a dry-run confirmation. Agent domain changes require human approval by default.

toolsPreview.name: verify_domain
toolsPreview.description: Refresh custom-domain DNS and SSL verification status. Agent domain changes require human approval by default.

toolsPreview.name: list_links
toolsPreview.description: List short links for the current registered account.

toolsPreview.name: get_link
toolsPreview.description: Get a single short link by alias for the current registered account.

toolsPreview.name: update_link
toolsPreview.description: Update a registered short link. Some fields require Pro.

toolsPreview.name: delete_link
toolsPreview.description: Delete a registered short link permanently.

toolsPreview.name: bulk_create_links
toolsPreview.description: Create multiple short links in one request. Free accounts can create up to 10 at a time, Pro up to 50.

toolsPreview.name: get_link_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get link analytics. Free accounts receive a basic total plus an upgrade hint; Pro accounts receive full breakdowns.

toolsPreview.name: check_alias
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a custom alias is available on a given domain before creating a link.

toolsPreview.name: list_tags
toolsPreview.description: List all tags for the current registered account. Tags help organise links into campaigns or categories.

toolsPreview.name: create_tag
toolsPreview.description: Create a new tag for organising links. Maximum 20 tags per account.

toolsPreview.name: delete_tag
toolsPreview.description: Delete a tag and remove it from all associated links.

toolsPreview.name: tag_link
toolsPreview.description: Add a tag to a short link for campaign or category organisation.

toolsPreview.name: untag_link
toolsPreview.description: Remove a tag from a short link.
